purpose: Add a PRESENT_ALL_AT_PATH condition check that requires every pattern in every named path, so an evidence condition can state that several facts must all still hold. PRESENT_AT_PATH matches with patterns.some(), which is right when the patterns are alternative spellings of one control and wrong when the condition means a conjunction - there, losing one fact leaves the decision standing on the half that remains. Additive only: no existing decision, check or verdict changes.
requiredInvariants: Purely additive: PRESENT_AT_PATH and ABSENT_AT_PATH keep their existing semantics exactly, so no decision already in the register changes verdict or gets rejected by this commit.
The existing missing-path guard and empty-pattern guard apply to the new check as well, and are covered by tests.

Tests encode both real failure modes found in the register rather than an abstract example: a condition whose second pattern is the rejection half of a signature check, and a two-path/two-pattern condition satisfied only along the diagonal.

No decision in docs/security/asvs-applicability-decisions.json is migrated in this scope - that revision needs per-condition judgement about whether the author meant AND or OR, plus a negative test each, and is deliberately left to a separate pass.
No production, REG.RU, DNS or database mutation.
acceptance: evaluateCondition supports PRESENT_ALL_AT_PATH, requiring every pattern in every named path.
node --test scripts/security/*.test.mjs passes, with new tests proving PRESENT_AT_PATH still holds when one of two named facts is removed while PRESENT_ALL_AT_PATH stops holding.
Rebuilding the matrix leaves decisionsApplied at 332 and decisionsRejected at 0 - the register is untouched by this change.
